name: comp-163
blurb: Three payment options as compact icon cards in a row.
description: Compact payment method selector with radio buttons, icons, and labels. Built on shadcn's RadioGroup with hidden radio inputs.
use_when: Choosing a payment method in a compact checkout flow or modal.
avoid_when: When you have many payment options or descriptions are needed.
a11y: Built on accessible RadioGroup with hidden radio inputs, text labels as click targets, and focus-visible styling.
